title: Fluke Census V3

sources.mechanic: Whale fluke individual recognition and tip/V landmarks.
Self-ordered selection of identities independent of their changing position.
Remember previously collected identities and avoid revisits.
Forage through multiple targets and distractors.
Hybrid identity foraging and costly incorrect collections.

transformation: Restore specimen sampling through the existing inertial camera. Exact neutral survey silhouettes conceal the seed-specific mapping from fluke shape to species name. Click a whole clear specimen in the live camera to reveal its name and WANTED/OFF LIST status safely; the field key retains all learned species shapes. Empty, clipped or obscured samples are recoverable. Preserve V2 numerical profiles, trajectories, camera physics, photography, landmarks and first-failure commitments. No probe quota, arbitrary unlock or source presentation assets. Field-key cards sort by displayed species name rather than hidden species index, so card position does not disclose the concealed mapping.
limitations: Source leads are inherited from V2, not newly reviewed research foundations. V3 browser automation is construction evidence; human approval, model calibration and native action-API equivalence are not established.
